title: Is Probing All You Need? Indicator Tasks as an Alternative to Probing Embedding Spaces

bias_targets.methodology: The paper measures gender bias in contextualized word embeddings using standard linear probes (classifying words as masculine or feminine) and indicator tasks, specifically the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) using career and family word sets, and KNN-bias correlation to detect implicit bias based on the neighbors of a target word.
